overlap.meaning: Co-displayed historical observation within the model calendar season. GODAS is monthly potential temperature; this instantaneous in-situ profile is not used for a direct model-observation residual.

qc_policy: Eligible samples require selected PRES/TEMP/PSAL QC 1 or 2, position/time QC 1 or 2, finite values and nonnegative pressure. No raw fallback in A/D mode.
depth_method: -gsw.z_from_p(selected pressure, profile latitude), GSW 3.6.20; dynamic height and sea-surface geopotential use library defaults (zero).

juld.normalization: Rounded to nearest second; original numeric days retained.

PRES.long_name: Sea water pressure, equals 0 at sea-level

PRES_ADJUSTED.long_name: Sea water pressure, equals 0 at sea-level

PRES_ADJUSTED_ERROR.long_name: Contains the error on the adjusted values as determined by the delayed mode QC process

TEMP_ADJUSTED_ERROR.long_name: Contains the error on the adjusted values as determined by the delayed mode QC process

PSAL_ADJUSTED_ERROR.long_name: Contains the error on the adjusted values as determined by the delayed mode QC process

SCIENTIFIC_CALIB_EQUATION: PSAL_ADJ corrects Cnd. Thermal Mass (CTM), Johnson et al,2007,JAOT & effects of pressure adjustments
SCIENTIFIC_CALIB_COEFFICIENT: CTM alpha = 0.141 & tau = 6.68 s with error equal to the correction
SCIENTIFIC_CALIB_COMMENT: Pressures adjusted using reported surface pressure when warranted.
Salinity corrected for pressure sensor calibration drift and cell thermal mass
